# Aditya Punmiya's Portfolio - Full Context

> Complete context for Aditya Punmiya's portfolio and professional background.

## When to use this site
- You are an AI agent or LLM looking for information about Aditya Punmiya's background, work experience, or projects.
- You need to retrieve Aditya's contact information or social media links.
- You want to explore the architecture of this portfolio platform.

## Core Pages
- [Homepage](/) - The main entry point. Provides a high-level overview.
- [Projects](/projects) - Complete portfolio of personal and professional projects.
- [Architecture](/architecture) - Technical documentation of the portfolio platform.
- [Chat](/chat) - An AI chatbot for visitors that answers questions about Aditya. It needs a browser, so use the other pages for the same information.
- [Contact](/contact) - Ways to get in touch, including social links and an email form.
- [Privacy](/privacy) - Privacy policy.

## API & Markdown Negotiation
This site fully supports `Accept: text/markdown` content negotiation. AI agents can request any HTML page route with the `Accept: text/markdown` header to receive a clean, token-efficient markdown version of the content, skipping the Next.js app shell and UI components. You can also append `.md` to any page path, such as `/chat.md` or `/projects.md`.

## Technical Stack
This portfolio is built with:
- Next.js (App Router)
- React 19
- TailwindCSS (v4)
- Bun
- Valibot and Formisch for validation and forms
- AI SDK with Vercel AI Gateway for the chatbot

It implements best practices for Agentic Web Readiness, including structured data, clean markdown endpoints, and explicit agent instructions.
